annotations.title: Record that a fix was applied

description: Records the date a finding's fix was made (not in the future); its effect is measured 28, 56 and 90 days on. Takes evidence_id from webops_finding; if the evidence changed since, nothing is recorded. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.
name: webops_mark_applied
title: Record that a fix was applied
